Reports filed here are published
By sending this report you agree that, once a moderator approves it, it goes on a public archive that anyone can read, search and download. Publication is permanent. You can ask later for a published report to be hidden from the public archive, but it cannot be unpublished as though it had never been public.
This covers the report itself — your answers, in your words. Your email address is not part of what is published, and anything you attached is asked about separately.
